text:
emma: quick sync — renewal alerts are noisy when healthscore oscillates during enablement training. proposing automated "outreach-pauser" when recent health_score variance > 0.15 in 72h to avoid false positive renewals.
ryan: makes sense. can we compute variance window in stream? current health pipeline emits rolling_avg and delta but not variance. quick SQL to get var: ```sql
SELECT account_id, var_samp(score) as variance
FROM account_health
WHERE ts > now() - interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING var_samp(score) > 0.15;
```
priya: if we pause outreach we should surface a reason in CS console and include a 'resume suggestion' based on stable-window: require 48h of var < 0.02 and trending_up > 0.01.
maria: UX note: show banner "Outreach paused — volatility detected" with link to timeline + quick resume button (requires justification).
cs-ops-bot: dry-run: outreach-pauser v1 scanned 5,042 staging accounts, 198 flagged for high variance. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/cs/outreach-pauser/4755554321
ryan: Implementation: 1) add health_variance check in alerting pipeline; 2) create pausers table pausers(account_id, reason, created_at, expires_at, metric_snapshot); 3) emit metric outreach.paused_reason=variance.
priya: add an allowlist: critical renewal cohort bypasses pauser (e.g., enterprise deals). Also an override header X-CS-force-outreach that must be logged and audited.
emma: retention for metric snapshots 30d, audit events 90d. legal ok with 90d. Also add alert if paused_count/day spikes > 500.
cs-ops-bot: task-created CS-9321 outreach-pauser backend (assignee: ryan), CS-9322 UI banner + resume flow (assignee: maria).
ryan: I'll PR the migration and pipeline patch today EOD. feature flag outreach_pauser_v1 default OFF. roll out 10% then ramp.
priya: QA: test cases for variance edge-cases, manual resume flow, override logging, and race when two agents try to resume simultaneously.
maria: I'll mock the banner and the justification modal. will include copy that ties to enablement playbook.
emma: thanks team 680 I'll draft a one-pager for CS explaining paused semantics and CLIs for manual override. closing thread, will post PR links here.
